finding.observation: The verifier treats source_class as an arbitrary non-empty string and rejects only four exact blacklist values: INSTALLER_SELF_REPORT, BUILDER_SELF_REPORT, MODEL_SELF_REPORT and EXECUTOR_SELF_REPORT. Any other unrecognized class is therefore eligible to satisfy the independent-readback gate when the remaining fields are clean.
finding.why_it_matters: The architecture contract requires independent target readback and explicitly states SELF_REPORT != COMPLETION_EVIDENCE. A blacklist is not a proof of independence. A producer-controlled alias such as MODEL_OUTPUT, INSTALLER_READBACK or any novel class can bypass the four-name blacklist and allow COMPLETE_AT_TWIN_SCOPE without a positively admitted independent evidence class.
finding.counterhypothesis: An upstream schema or trusted adapter may guarantee that source_class can only contain approved independent values before this function is called. No such validation is performed by verify_target_obligations itself, and the current tests call the function directly with caller-supplied mappings, so the component contract is not fail-closed at its public boundary.

minimal_reproduction.input_change_from_green_test: Use the existing otherwise-clean observation fixture but set source_class to MODEL_OUTPUT (or another non-empty value not in the four-entry blacklist).
minimal_reproduction.code_path: _identifier accepts the string; the _FORBIDDEN_SELF_REPORT_SOURCES membership test is false; no unknown/fail reason is added from source_class; all other green fields can therefore produce PASS and top-level COMPLETE_AT_TWIN_SCOPE.
minimal_reproduction.expected_fail_closed_behavior: Unknown/unadmitted evidence-source classes must yield UNKNOWN or input rejection; only positively admitted independent source classes may contribute PASS evidence.

test_gap: Current tests cover INSTALLER_SELF_REPORT and MODEL_SELF_REPORT blacklist hits, but do not test an unknown or semantically self-reporting alias outside the blacklist.
required_resolution: Replace blacklist-only independence with a positive allowlist or typed evidence-source authority contract.
Fail closed on unknown source_class values.
Add regression tests showing MODEL_OUTPUT/INSTALLER_READBACK/arbitrary unknown classes cannot produce COMPLETE_AT_TWIN_SCOPE.
If independence is established by an upstream authority object instead of a string enum, bind that authority/provenance deterministically and test its stale/wrong-generation cases.
